name: Ash-Lantern Skirmisher
rationale: A low-ranking warrior turns discarded memories into stored glow, then spends that charge to call a radiant fighting echo.

name: Kindling Oathguard
rationale: This warrior is bound to answer the smallest new spark, rising from the void whenever a fragile ally is materialized.

name: Tap the Bright Vein
rationale: The event reads as a quick cut into a luminous current, trading a small moment for a sudden rush of usable energy.

name: Read Beyond the Toll
rationale: The player buys deeper vision at the cost of letting the opponent advance, as though every revelation opens a road for a rival.

name: The Host Becomes Tide
rationale: A full company reaches a mythic breaking point where every ally magnifies the rest and the formation surges past all resistance.

name: Gather the Falling Names
rationale: The event frames dissolution as a rescue of identity, catching allies at the moment they fall and carrying them back as remembered names.

name: Dawnburrow Forager
rationale: A tiny spirit animal finds usable energy only when the pack is already gathered and the Dawn trigger opens the ground.

name: Echoquill Witness
rationale: This quiet character records each event as it happens, turning spellwork into a fresh vision and then shedding one fading thought.
